newsitem.title: UK: CA, ING, Paribas to lead Brazil's parallel bonds.
newsitem.headline: CA, ING, Paribas to lead Brazil's parallel bonds.

text.p: Creditanstalt-Bankverein, ING and Paribas have won the mandate to lead manage Brazil's upcoming debut parallel bond issue, syndicate sources said on Monday.
They said each bank would lead manage one tranche -- CABV the Austrian shilling tranche, ING the guilder tranche and Paribas the French franc tranche.
Each tranche is expected to be for $200 million equivalent with a five-year maturity. The total size thus being $600 million equivalent.
The roadshow will begin next week with the launch expected by the end of the month, sources close to the deal said.
Brazil recently asked banks for proposals to launch Eurobonds in several European currencies which would be fungible after the introduction of a single European currency.
Brazil was said to have left the choice of currencies up to the bidders but had suggested marks, guilders, French francs and Austrian schillings as possible denominations.
